 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League C - Game Week 6 15 Nov 2026 - 12:00 Bolt Arena Finland host San Marino at Bolt Arena in Helsinki in a UEFA Nations League C fixture, with Jacob Friis's side looking to return to winning ways on home soil.
 Finland come into this match off back-to-back defeats. They lost 2-0 to Albania on November 12 and fell 1-0 to Belarus earlier in the campaign, leaving them third in the group standings.
 Before that difficult run, Finland showed they can hurt teams at this level. A 7-0 win over San Marino in September and a 2-1 victory over Albania demonstrated their attacking quality when things click.
 San Marino arrive without a point from their five Nations League matches. Roberto Cevoli's side have conceded heavily throughout the campaign, shipping four goals to Belarus and seven to Finland in the reverse fixture.
 The gulf in quality between these two sides has been consistent across their recent meetings. San Marino have lost all five of their last five competitive matches, conceding at least twice in most of them.
